DIRECT ACCESS TO MORAINE LAKE! #1 Tour from Canmore

Experience Moraine Lake the easy way with this 4-hr adventure, designed for those who want to fully enjoy its beauty.

We’ll pick you up in Canmore, Harvie Heights, Banff or Lake Louise. With direct access, you can simply relax and take in the views as we handle the details.

At Moraine Lake, enjoy 4 hrs to explore at your own pace. Hike the serene Lakeshore Trail or challenge yourself with Tower of Babel, Larch Valley, Consolation Lakes, Eiffel Peak or Sentinel Pass. You can also take in views from the iconic Rockpile or rent a canoe on the turquoise waters.

This tour offers a hassle-free way to immerse yourself in Moraine Lake’s beauty. Book today for an unforgettable experience!

Popular hikes: Consolation Lakes (1.5–2 hrs), Eiffel Lake (3–4 hrs), Sentinel Pass (2.5–4.5 hrs), Tower of Babel (2.5–4 hrs). Not into hiking? Relax, climb, canoe or picnic!
